overview: 19 official Qs (2008, 2012, 2017, 2019, 2024, 2025); 2025 Mains alone has 9. Renewable sources and capacities lead (8 Qs). Formats: one-liners on ranks, firsts and locations; 2024-25 add multiple-correct (GBA supporters, MNRE mission), matching (AP solar park capacities), A-R (biofuel policy) and NOT-questions (ISA projects).

possibility.angle: Installed capacities and power-sector issues (India and AP)
possibility.what_they_ask: Dominant power source (thermal), AP generation ratio GENCO:private:central, which item is NOT a power-sector problem
Challenges in oil consumption (import dependence, price volatility)

possibility.angle: National Energy Policy and DISCOM reform (UDAY)
possibility.what_they_ask: Coverage figure of UDAY; in other APPSC exams: aim of NEP, UDAY features

possibility.angle: National Policy on Biofuels and Global Biofuel Alliance
possibility.what_they_ask: NBCC role on surplus grain ethanol (A-R), non-G20 supporters of GBA
Natural targets: BS-VI nationwide from 1 April 2020, BS-V skipped, what BS norms limit (vehicle exhaust pollutants), sulphur content

possibility.evidence: 1 Q: 2008; frequent in other APPSC exams (KG basin, coal grades)
possibility.what_they_ask: Layering in an oil trap, gas constituents; natural targets: anthracite highest grade, KG basin gas, LPG/CNG composition
Device energy conversion, biogas gas, geothermal site, leading RE source/state (time-stamped), India's world rank in wind, AP solar park capacities, first 100% RE city

possibility.angle: New RE initiatives: MNRE, ISA, NCEF
possibility.what_they_ask: MNRE mission elements, project not under ISA (KUSUM), goal of NCEF

traps.trap: Leader that was true earlier [time-stamp swap]
traps.spot: Rank/leader question on RE state or source; an older leader is offered
traps.fix: Gujarat leads wind capacity since 2023-24 (earlier Tamil Nadu); India 4th in world wind
Photocell: light → electricity; LED/lamp: electricity → light
traps.pyq: 'electrical energy into light energy' → light into electrical [group2-2008-paper1#2]

traps.fix: Biogas, CNG, marsh gas = methane; LPG = butane + propane

traps.trap: Domestic scheme slipped into an international alliance list
traps.fix: ISA: OSOWOG, ISTAR-C, ITEC-linked training; PM-KUSUM is India's own solar-pump scheme

traps.trap: Fund's purpose inverted or swapped with another fund
traps.spot: Options include the thing the fund taxes or another green fund's job
traps.fix: NCEF: coal cess financing clean energy; forest work = CAMPA
traps.pyq: 'Promote coal-based power' / 'forest conservation' → renewable energy, cut emissions [mains-2025-paper2#76]

traps.fix: Density decides: water bottom, oil middle, gas top
traps.pyq: 'gas, oil, water' is descending → water, oil, gas [group2-2008-paper1#21]

traps.trap: Both statements true but the link is not the reason
traps.spot: A-R where R is a real policy line
traps.fix: Ask whether R explains the specific rule in A (NBCC approval) or something else
traps.pyq: R (farmer price risk) true but does not explain NBCC approval [mains-2025-paper2#132]

traps.trap: One extra non-member in a list of supporters
traps.fix: Locate the odd country (Chile not a GBA launch supporter) and drop codes containing it
traps.pyq: Chile excluded → I, II, III, IV and VI [prelims-2024#102]

techniques.name: Date-stamp the ranking [which year?]
techniques.how: For any 'largest/most important/leading' RE question, fix the reference year first: wind led India's RE capacity until ~2019-20, solar after; state leaders also changed.
techniques.example: Largest wind producer asked in 2025 → post-2023 data → Gujarat, not Tamil Nadu [mains-2025-paper2#135]

techniques.name: Odd-element elimination in multiple-correct
techniques.how: Find one item you are sure is out (or in); strike every code that contradicts it; repeat.
techniques.example: Chile not a supporter → only option 4 lacks V → I, II, III, IV and VI [prelims-2024#102]

techniques.name: Size ladder for matching
techniques.how: Rank the list-I items by known size and pair with sorted capacities.
techniques.example: Ramagiri hybrid is smallest (160), NP Kunta/Ananthapuram-I biggest (1500), Kurnool 1000, Ananthapuram-II 500 → a-II, b-III, c-I, d-IV [mains-2025-paper2#133]

techniques.name: Physics reasoning for devices and layers
techniques.how: Derive from the principle: conversions named in the device, density for layering.
techniques.example: Photo-electric = light in, electricity out → option 4 [group2-2008-paper1#2]

techniques.name: Membership test for NOT-questions
techniques.how: Classify each option as domestic or international, policy or project; the one in the other class is the answer.
techniques.example: OSOWOG, ISTAR-C, ITEC all ISA-linked; KUSUM domestic → KUSUM [mains-2025-paper2#134]

confusions.remember: Photocell light → electricity; LED electricity → light
ISA = international alliance, HQ Gurugram; KUSUM = MNRE farm solar
NCEF coal cess for clean energy; CAMPA compensatory afforestation
Answer by the year of the question
Puga = most promising geothermal field per GSI
Ananthapuram-I bigger than Kurnool; Ananthapuram-II 500; Ramagiri hybrid 160
Diu = first city on 100% RE by day; Kochi = first fully solar airport

anchors: Thermal (coal) = largest share of India's power generation
India: 4th largest installed wind capacity in the world (2024-25)
Diu = first city to run on 100% renewable energy in daytime
Puga Valley, Ladakh = most promising geothermal field
Oil trap layering: gas over oil over water
National Policy on Biofuels 2018: NBCC approves surplus-grain ethanol
Global Biofuel Alliance launched 9 Sep 2023 at New Delhi G20
NCEF from Budget 2010-11, financed by coal cess
UDAY (Nov 2015): states take over 75% of DISCOM debt
BS-VI norms nationwide from 1 April 2020 (BS-V skipped)
checklist: Which year does the question refer to? Rankings and leaders change
Is the direction of energy conversion or order (ascending/descending) the trap?
Is the option domestic or international, a fund or a scheme?
In multiple-correct, find one sure outsider and strike codes
In A-R, does R explain the specific clause of A?
For capacity matching, rank items by size first
